author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Today's the day! Valve's long-awaited Steam Frame virtual reality headset launches, and we dive deep into how it performs after testing it for over two weeks. From stand-alone games to those streamed from a PC, here's how the Steam Frame compares to both mobile VR headsets like the Quest 3 as well as tethered PC VR headsets like Bigscreen Beyond. Does it live up to expectations? 

Steam Frame pre-order: https://store.steampowered.com/hardware/steamframe

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the Cinema Relics collection archive, Adam meets two of the memorable worm aliens created for Men in Black! These foam latex puppets, which been meticulously and beautifully restored, are still connected to the original mechanical cabling system used to animate them during filming. We're amazed by how their skin and paint details hold up to close scrutiny!

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
